title: Differential conformational expansion of NUP98-HOXA9 oncoprotein from nanosized assemblies to macrophases.
authors: Ruan, Hao; Dillenburg, Rodrigo F; Hosseini, Elnaz; Wittmann, Sina; Girard, Martin; Lemke, Edward A
one_liner_zh: 该文通过实验与模拟结合，研究NUP98-HOXA9嵌合转录因子FG结构域在不同组装态下的构象动态，虽涉及TF-DNA结合域暴露，但核心聚焦相分离组装而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法可迁移至本课题。
abstract: Transcription factors (TFs) play a central role in gene regulation by binding to specific DNA sequences and orchestrating the transcriptional machinery. A majority of eukaryotic TFs have a block copolymer architecture, with at least one block being a folded DNA interaction domain, and another block being highly enriched in intrinsic disorder. In this study, we focus on NUP98-HOXA9 (NHA9), a chimeric TF implicated in leukemogenesis. By integrating experiments and simulations, we examine the structural dynamics of NHA9's FG domain across assembly states. We find that the FG domain has different conformational compactness in the monomeric, oligomeric, and densely packed condensate state. Notably, the oligomeric state exhibits micelle-like organization with non-fixed stoichiometry, with the DNA-binding domain exposed at the periphery. These findings offer molecular insight into the phase behaviour of NHA9 and highlight dynamic conformational transitions of intrinsically disordered regions during molecular assembly, with implications for understanding transcriptional regulation in cancer.
abstract_zh: 转录因子（TFs）通过结合特定DNA序列并协调转录机制，在基因调控中发挥核心作用。大多数真核转录因子具有嵌段共聚物结构，至少一个嵌段为折叠的DNA相互作用域，另一个嵌段则高度富集内在无序性。在本研究中，我们聚焦于NUP98-HOXA9（NHA9），一种与白血病发生相关的嵌合转录因子。通过整合实验与模拟，我们考察了NHA9的FG域在不同组装状态下的结构动力学。我们发现，FG域在单体、寡聚及致密凝聚体状态下表现出不同的构象紧凑性。值得注意的是，寡聚状态展现出具有非固定化学计量比的胶束样组织，其中DNA结合域暴露于外围。这些发现为NHA9的相行为提供了分子层面的见解，并强调了内在无序区域在分子组装过程中的动态构象转变，对理解癌症中的转录调控具有重要意义。
